snippet.title: RTS meets RPG - Lead from the Front: RTS Hero Trailer
snippet.description:
KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tiltgames/rts-hero-my-rts-where-you-zoom-in-and-command-the-hero
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/QsGvKhkDjS
STEAM PAGE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499940/RTS_Hero/

RTS Hero is a simplified real time strategy game where you can manage your units, buildings and resources from a top-down perspective, and the player can also take direct control of a hero on the battlefield from a third person perspective and fight enemies head on!

Players can choose between various heroes with unique abilities and playstyles.

RTS Hero seeks to put a twist on the genre by making a more casual and fun approach to combat while maintaining the planning/strategy elements of classic RTS games.
